page.overview:
Who is Tyrannosaurus?

Tyrannosaurus is a small, white mouse, with a long hairless tail, red eyes, and a cheerful look.

Most of the time it stands on his rear legs, keeping its front legs raised in a standard mouse pose somewhat resembling a Tyrannosaurus Rex, which probably gave it the name.

After the two-year timeskip, it wore a miniature pinstriped suit jacket over a dark-colored shirt and light-colored tie.

Tyrannosaurus spends most of its time lying in Iceburg's breast pocket and squeaking happily when Iceburg caresses him.
